gender and voice type of a robot's vocal features clearly influence subsequent judgments and acceptance of the robot and especially so when participant gender is taken into account.
the robot voice is a powerful tool to influence anthropomorphic perceptions, but that the effects of this voice are not uniform across all people.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
anthropomorphic inferences and HRI-acceptance are not only influenced by the robot's appearance, but also by the robot's voice.
the robot's vocal cues have an impact on the anthropomorphic perception of the robot.
the robot's vocal features are an important aspect of social interaction.
